7.5.3 Skipping Authentication for Secured I-PDUs at SecOC
[SWS_SecOC_00265]⌈ For a Rx Secured I-PDU with SecOCSecuredRxPduVerification=false, the SecOC module shall extract the Authentic I-PDU without Authentication.
⌋(SRS_BSW_00385)
